name: blender low poly character scene prep
goal: Prepare a Blender 4+ scene for stylized low-poly character work: Eevee, Standard view transform, incremental saves, image references, Rigify metarig scale.

source.title: Blender Low Poly Character Modeling Tutorial - Part 1

outputs.name: prepared_blend
outputs.description: .blend with refs aligned and metarig scale reference

constraints: Render engine Eevee; disable AO/bloom/SSR/motion blur as stated
Color Management View Transform = Standard (not AgX) for stylized/game-like colors
Enable Rigify add-on for Human Meta-Rig scale reference

steps.action: Render Properties: Engine Eevee; ensure Ambient Occlusion, Bloom, Screen Space Reflections, Motion Blur off.
Delete default cube if desired; File → Save As into a project folder; use Ctrl+S often and Ctrl+Alt+S for incremental saves.
Shift+A → Image → Reference; import front and side images.
Edit → Preferences → Add-ons → enable Rigify; Shift+A → Armature → Human Meta-Rig for human scale.
Select both references; front ortho view; Alt+G/Alt+S/Alt+R reset as needed; R then X 90 to stand images up.
G/S and axis locks (G+Z, G+Y, R+Z 90) to align feet to ground and match metarig height; set reference Opacity ~0.5.

verification: Front and side refs visible and roughly human-scaled
